subject: biology-1
question: A cell makes a protein that it will release into the bloodstream. After synthesis on the rough endoplasmic reticulum, which sequence of structures does the protein follow on its way out of the cell?

options.text: Rough endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi apparatus to secretory vesicle to plasma membrane.
Smooth endoplasmic reticulum to lysosome to Golgi apparatus to plasma membrane.
Golgi apparatus to rough endoplasmic reticulum to peroxisome to plasma membrane.
Nucleus to rough endoplasmic reticulum to cytoplasm to plasma membrane.

explanation: The secretory pathway runs from the rough ER to the Golgi apparatus, where proteins are modified and sorted, then into a secretory vesicle that fuses with the plasma membrane to release the protein. B fails because the smooth ER does not handle secreted proteins and lysosomes do not deliver cargo outward. C fails because the Golgi acts after the rough ER, not before it. D fails because proteins are not made in the nucleus.
